title: Admit the legal team's IP chain-of-title checklist
ask: Approve or refuse the legal lead's proposed skill legal/ip-chain-check.
why_now: Third similar ask this month; the proposal passed G0 to G4.
if_ignored: The next IP question is answered by hand again.

decision.question: Admit legal/ip-chain-check as an active skill of the legal team?

options.label: Admit it
options.effect: Moves the proposal to the team's skills; the roster marks it active.

options.label: Refuse
options.effect: The proposal stays inert and is marked refused in the growth log.

predicted_objection.reason: Prefers checklists over new skills when a reference line would do.
predicted_objection.instead: Make it a checklist item in the existing legal skill.
